summary: Tested the Rakhigarhi 'The Ambition' split into 3 independent text boxes on the fresh bundle. Public layout: at 1920, 1280 and 768 boxes 1 and 2 stack on the left and box 3 is vertically centred (left midpoint and right midpoint match within 0.5px). The divider is a 1px #ddd6cf span, top 15% and height 70.0% of .ambition-body, placed at the column split. At 390 the boxes stack in reading order 1, 2, 3 with a horizontal rule above box 3, the divider is hidden and there is no horizontal overflow. LiveEditor (1920): each box is selected separately with its own label ('Text box 1/2/3') and a selection box that fits it exactly. Inline edit of box 2 left boxes 1 and 3 unchanged. Undo/redo worked. Font size on box 1 affected only box 1. Moving box 3 left boxes 1 and 2 in place. Enter inside box 3 creates a second paragraph. Save writes the new shape (body_1/2/3_html, no body_html) to published and draft. A fresh logged-out public load matches the editor (text, font size, box 3 offset). Reset Position re-centres box 3. Clearing box 2 keeps it selectable, and new text typed into it saves. Admin PageEditor shows 3 rich fields (section-8-body_N_html, labels 'Text box N'), filled from the old body_html. Save draft writes the new shape, published stays unchanged, admin preview shows the draft edit and the public page does not. Backend pytest 4/4: SSR renders the old body_html shape; live_save round-trips the 3 boxes plus styles; script and onclick are stripped and a malicious style value is rejected; draft mirrors published (has_unpublished_changes=false); SSR shows all 3 boxes; other sections are untouched; an empty box is accepted; auth is required. Regression checks: Rakhigarhi headings, Haveli/Chaupal, Archaeology, homepage and the Haveli note caption all show content. The Rakhigarhi page doc was restored after every test to the original backup taken at the start (old body_html shape, styles, draft). backup_restore_content.py diff is clean.

minor.issue: No concurrency check: live_save replaces the whole section list from whatever the client holds. During testing another admin session (not my scripts) did a live save at 13:52:04 UTC. It carried my temporary TEST_PARA3 text (in the DB only between 13:50 and 13:51) plus a stray '8' at the start of box 1 and a box 3 translate/width change. So a stale editor tab overwrote published content. I restored the original. Consider a version/updated_at check that returns 409 when it is stale.

critical_code_review_comments: AmbitionBody puts the old sx(s,'body_html') (style, ref, typography) on the group wrapper. styles.body_html {fontSize:18px} is kept forever after migration and still applies to the group, but nothing in the editor can select it any more (no data-edit). Consider dropping styles.body_html for this layout once it has been copied to the boxes.

normalizeReferenceContent puts every top-level node after the 2nd into box 3, and loose inline/text nodes become separate items. Fine for the current content, but if the source has a
or inline nodes between paragraphs, the split could land in the wrong place.
SSR only detects the new shape via the 'body_1_html' key, so a partial save with only body_2/3 would fall back to body_html (which will be gone). Low risk because the editor always writes all three.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST_ edits were reverted by restoring the full rakhigarhi page doc from /tmp/content_backup_iter13.json. The DB is in the old body_html shape (as before testing). The new shape is written on the next real editor save.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the browser scripts with: PYTHONPATH=$(/root/.venv/bin/python -c 'import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])') /opt/plugins-venv/bin/python3 /app/tests/rak_ambition_three_boxes_editor.py. Both scripts back up and restore the rakhigarhi doc. The SSR endpoint is /api/ssr?path=... (not /api/public/ssr). The selected-label is CSS uppercased. The live-reset-pos button sits inside a collapsed <details>, so open it first. The Rakhigarhi ambition section is block index 8. Watch for other admin sessions live-saving at the same time: check the revisions collection (entity_id=rakhigarhi) for saves that are not yours.
rca of the issue: Unexpected content change at 13:52:04 UTC came from a separate admin LiveEditor session holding stale state (it contained transient test text), not from the feature code. Cause: live_save has no optimistic concurrency check. Mitigation: restored the original doc; consider an updated_at precondition.
